1704-2757-5362-7694.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-2757-5362-7694.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untapping a basic land.
Activate that basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Multiversal Incursion, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying Multiversal Incursion for each flip you won, and returning the original to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of Multiversal Incursion, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Krark each time.
If Multiversal Incursion is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Multiversal Incursion card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Quantum Misalignment, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Multiversal Incursion and Quantum Misalignment end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

907-2645-2930-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2645-2930-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3536-4067-5078-7914.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

215-6071-7781.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six permanent cards in your graveyard.
215-6071-7781.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, causing The Core to become a creature and untapping it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3025-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1458-1594-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-1594-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-6887-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2921-4871-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4871-5220-5651.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

321-399-1594-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2557-5526-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-5526-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

11-1927-4377-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-4377-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Walk the Aeons and returning the original Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Walk the Aeons from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

539-5414-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3327-4613-5073-6258.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4613-5073-6258.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

372-3306-4823.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Timeless Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
372-3306-4823.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1534-2134-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{U}
1534-2134-4276.description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, copying Bond of Insight.
Resolve the copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards, and returning Turnabout and Twincast from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to infinitely cast instants instead of continuing to copy Turnabout.

222-308-2511-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

307-344-3821.notablePrerequisites:
Skullsnatcher and Peregrine Drake do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Skullsnatcher or Peregrine Drake.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
307-344-3821.description:
Declare Peregrine Drake and Skullsnatcher as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Skullsnatcher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake that is tapped and attacking.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Peregrine Drake tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

4191-4229-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Islands.
Archelos is tapped.
4191-4229-4826.description:
Cast Selkie Hedge-Mage by paying {0}.
Selkie Hedge-Mage enters the battlefield tapped due to Archelos, triggering its second ability, as well as its first ability if you control at least two Forests.
If applicable, resolve the first Selkie Hedge-Mage trigger, causing you to gain three life.
Resolve the second Selkie Hedge-Mage trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2869-3184-3518.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Yomiji triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1636-2532-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
1636-2532-5231.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Thermopod with haste.
The Thermopod token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Thermopod token, adding {R}.
The Thermopod token dies, triggering itself, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1679-2034-2302-4963.notablePrerequisites:
"Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You have a way to draw a card.
1679-2034-2302-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Draw a card, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token instead.
The Bear token enters the battlefield, triggering Dire Undercurrents' first ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bear token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Resolve the Dire Undercurrents trigger from step 3, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2188-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2188-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
The creature leaves the battlefield, triggering Flaming Fist Officer, putting a +1/+1 counter on Flaming Fist Officer.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2104-2556-3395.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
